neighbours.label: ' been' (and ' a' after 'remains') in present-perfect passive assessments of a claim or research area: 'has been disputed', 'has largely been ignored', 'remains a mystery'
fire: Critics say the new findings have been overstated by the press.
For a common illness, migraine has been poorly funded by most governments.
His account of the battle has since been challenged by several historians.
The origin of the custom has been the subject of much speculation.
Exactly how the ancient builders moved the stones remains a mystery today.
Until recently, the role of gut bacteria had been largely overlooked by doctors.
That early estimate has been widely criticised by other economists.
Sadly, the question of rural poverty has been neglected by researchers.
quiet: Critics say the press overstated the new findings last week.
For a common illness, migraine gets little funding from most governments.
Several historians challenged his account of the battle in their books.
Much speculation surrounds the origin of the custom in the village.
Ancient builders moved the stones using ramps, sledges and ropes.
Doctors now study the role of gut bacteria in many diseases.
Other economists widely criticised that early estimate in their reports.
